raw_segments.text: His vacant face stared pityingly at the postscript.
Hurry, piano downstairs, coming out of her shell,
row with her in the Excel cafe about the bracelet,
wouldn't eat her cakes or speak or look, sauce box.
He sopped other dyes of bread in the gravy
and eight piece after piece of kidney.
12 and six a week, not much.
He drank a draft of cooler tea to wash down his meal.
Then he read the letter again, twice.
